text:
Alex: CobaltHealth sent their acceptance criteria. They want a perf POC next Wed: mixed traffic (gen 65% / embed 35%), sustained target 150 rps, p95 < 250ms, p99 < 600ms. Also asked for a monthly cost estimate at ~50M tokens/mo and whether we support CMK/KMS. Can we run this on Dedicated?

Jamie: Yep, we can provision. @Nikhil can you own the load plan and results? Sofia please prep the security blurb.

Nikhil: I got it. Initial thoughts: 150 rps sustained with mixed gen/embed is plausible on a 3-GPU slice for larger models, 2-GPU might be marginal depending on quantization. Plan: warmup -> stepped ramp (50 -> 100 -> 150) with 15m at each step and a 20m soak at target. We'll capture p50/p95/p99, tokens, and per-token cost.

Nikhil: Repro snippet (wrk2 + json payload, simplified):
```bash
cat > payload.json <<'JSON'
{"model":"cobalt-13b-lite","input":"<user_prompt>","max_tokens":64}
JSON
# warmup low RPS for 10m
wrk -t6 -c50 -d10m -s ./scripts/post.lua -- "https://redwood.example/v1/generate" > warmup.log
# ramp 50/100/150 rps, 15m each
for r in 50 100 150; do
  ./scripts/run_rate.sh --rate $r --duration 15m --payload payload.json > run_${r}.log
done
# soak
./scripts/run_rate.sh --rate 150 --duration 20m --payload payload.json > soak.log
```
(we'll mix an embed call every 3rd request via post.lua)

Sofia: Security: yes, Dedicated and Private support customer-managed keys (CMK) via our KMS integration. HSM-backed keys can be used in Private installs. We also have SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 summaries available. I'll attach the one-pager.

Jamie: infra-bot, reserve dedicated pool for 2026-04-02 13:00 UTC for ~2.5h.

infra-bot: Allocation created: dedicated-medium (3x GPU slices) start 2026-04-02T13:00:00Z duration 3h id alloc-cc7e.

Alex: Pricing ask: customer wants a ballpark for 50M tokens/month. Quick back-of-envelope: hosted API retail ~ $0.0007/token -> $35k/mo. Dedicated amortized (3-GPU) incl infra & ops at 70% util -> ~$28k/mo; 2-GPU ~ $20k/mo at similar util. Need Nikhil to list assumptions (avg tokens per call, utilization, quantization).

Nikhil: Will include a cost table in runbook with scenarios: hosted, dedicated-2, dedicated-3. Assumptions: avg tokens/gen=110, avg tokens/embed=16, mix 65/35, util 60/80/95%. I'll also show fp16 vs int8 throughput deltas.

Sofia: Also note for the security questionnaire: audit logs retention is configurable, we can provide evidence of key separation, and provide redacted SOC2 report via secure share.

Jamie: Runbook checklist for the run: 1) prewarm 10-15m short prefixes to prime KV; 2) stepped ramp 50/100/150 (15m each); 3) soak 20m; 4) capture logs: wrk logs, prometheus snapshots, GPU telemetry; 5) abort criteria: p99 > 900ms or GPU mem > 90% or error rate > 2%.

Nikhil: Post-run deliverables: run_50.log, run_100.log, run_150.log, soak.log, prometheus snapshots, 1-page exec summary with RPS achieved and p50/p95/p99, token counts, and revised cost per million tokens. I'll also include a small note on throughput sensitivity to quantization.

Alex: If we see tail issues, we'll propose fallback policy: route to smaller-sequence model variant or enable more aggressive batching. Include that in the customer packet as options and tradeoffs.

Sofia: I'll prepare the KMS + compliance appendix and attach to the packet.

Jamie: Great. Nikhil, ping me when you start the run so CS can watch the demo. :thumbsup:

Nikhil: Will do. Plan timeline: warmup 15m -> ramp 45m -> soak 20m -> post-checks 10m. Total ~90m. I'll post artifacts right after and a short writeup with graphs.

infra-bot: Reminder: allocation alloc-cc7e scheduled to start 2026-04-02T13:00:00Z.
